_about: Sources of the "In plain words" lines (data.json plain, tools/apply_plain_sheets.py): each line is a synthesis in the app's own words of how these describe the genus, plus the IMR lecture notes, ID tips and the genus's own photos; no sentence is copied. Checked 2026-11-03.
_corrections: 2026-11-03, approved by Pierre: four IMR wordings corrected after these sources (tools/apply_imr_corrections.py, tools/id_tips.txt): Seriatopora corallites in neat rows, not black (Corals of the World S. hystrix, Wikipedia, Naturalis); Lobactis tentacular lobes often green, blue or white, not pale (Corals of the World F. scutaria); Heliofungia tentacle tips white or pink (Corals of the World H. actiniformis); Herpolitha free-living like a mushroom coral but with many mouths: the IMR "solitary" and the Coral Finder / Corals of the World "colonial" both hold, Hoeksema 1989 says monostomatous / polystomatous instead.
